findings.title: Three preparations use the wrong mineral-stock category
findings.observation: All three payloads say MINERAL_STOCK. The schema defines that as Concentrated mineral stock solution. JCM378 is a nutrient-containing basal preparation;50% methanol is organic-substrate stock; resazurin is indicator preparation. Schema-enum membership alone does not support the scientific category.
